_comment: Quotation job for DORA Doors (Iraq) - door hardware. DRAFT v2 2026-10-06, for the boss to check.
Customer sent his 'Hardware Order' list (an order already in production elsewhere): quote on it,
without the knob. Boss 2026-10-06: 30/70, 30 days, EXW, quantities per the list.
Pricing rule (boss): the dearer quote x1.15, the cheaper x1.2, take the lower; single source x1.2.
RMB -> USD at 6.71.
thumbturn   7.30 (one source):           7.30x1.2 =  8.76 -> USD 1.31
door stop   8.00 (Limingyang, satin, one source): 8.00x1.2 = 9.60 -> USD 1.43
hinge       NO VALID PRICE: customer confirmed SS201; both costs (2.50, 5.30) are iron/carbon steel.
Spec mismatches for the boss (customer's chat vs the cost quote we hold):
lock case: customer wants zinc latch AND deadbolt, 201 SS strike, matt black, rounded front plate,
85x45; the 10.30 cost is zinc latch, iron deadbolt/faceplate, chrome.
door stop: customer list says chrome finish; the 8.00 cost is satin.
Not quoted: item 5 lever handle (no cost yet), item 6 knob (customer asked to leave it out).
Trademark: lock case no extra charge; cylinder needs MOQ 2,000 pcs (chat).
Open with customer: cylinders keyed alike / master keyed, keys per cylinder; he asked for 'with shipping'
but the boss set EXW.
Build:  py scripts/build-quotation.py docs/quotations/dora-doors-iraq-20261006.json
v3 2026-10-06: boss chose the 2.50 hinge (x1.2 = RMB 3.00 / USD 0.45 per pair; cost quote was iron, customer asked SS201 - boss decision); lever row added with qty, price to be filled by the boss.
v4: lever from Gadlord: black powder coat 19.50 x1.2 = 23.40 (USD 3.49); MSN plated 21.00 x1.2 = 25.20 (USD 3.76) shown as option. Customer list said chrome - neither offered.

v5 2026-10-06 boss: every cost x1.2 then /6.7 (no 1.15). Cheapest of Laomao sheet / Karl / Jiadegu / Limingyang / Gadlord: lock 10.30, dbl cyl 6.80 (Karl), thumbturn 7.30, hinge 201 3.00/pair (Jiadegu), door stop polished chrome 9.30 (Limingyang), lever black 19.50 (Gadlord).
